task: BRD-036 (Learning Methodology Examples, Best-Practice Ledger and the Review-Triage Learning Loop): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Business rules BRU-036-01 to BRU-036-08 trace directly to ADR-036 sections 4.1 to 4.5 and Invariants 1 to 9, and stay inside ADR-002, ADR-003 Invariant 6 and ADR-024.
Success metrics are concrete and checkable (32 of 32 entries, zero class mismatches, zero adopted entries without real episodes, zero guessed triage fields, zero new record types), not aspirational.

Out of scope excludes effectiveness claims, changes to a methodology state, building unbuilt methodologies, autonomy over accept or decline, trace_id, and code for blocked, excluded or declined methods.
BRU-036-01 to BRU-036-08 are concrete enough to drive an FDD and contract tests, with one remaining soft rule: what counts as a labeled example is defined in the ADR, not restated.
